big-bass-bonanza.description: Fishing as a game mechanic: the fisherman collects cash-symbol values during free spins.
big-bass-bonanza.feature: Further fisherman appearances advance the bonus round towards extra spins and multipliers.
big-bass-bonanza.note: It is easier to follow symbol collection here than paylines. This is a distinct type of bonus progression, worth comparing with cascades.

cards.title: 10–20 free spins
cards.text: Three, four or five Scatters trigger the bonus with 10, 15 or 20 free spins respectively. The starting number of spins is determined by the number of Scatters.

cards.title: The fisherman collects cash values
cards.text: During the bonus, the fisherman Wild collects the values of all visible cash symbols. Cash symbols do not collect themselves: a Wild must appear on the same spin.

cards.title: A retrigger for every fourth Wild
cards.text: Every fourth collected Wild adds another 10 free spins. The Wild counter therefore has more influence on bonus progression than the number of cash symbols in an individual spin.

cards.title: Multipliers 2x → 3x → 10x
cards.text: The first, second and third retriggers move collection into stages with 2x, 3x and 10x multipliers. This progression belongs to the original Big Bass Bonanza bonus round.

jammin-jars.description: A large 8 × 8 grid, cluster pays and cascades. Wild jars move across the grid and increase their multiplier after participating in a win.
jammin-jars.feature: A payout requires a cluster of five or more matching fruit symbols. The symbols then disappear and start another cascade.
jammin-jars.note: The animation can be difficult to follow on a large grid. Focus on the positions of the Wild jars and the clusters in which they actually participate.
jammin-jars.metricsNote: Push Gaming states a fixed maximum of 20 000x for the original Jammin’ Jars; the current game page separately lists a Highest Observed Win of 19 998.5x.
additionalSourceLabels: Push Gaming interview about Jammin’ Jars 2

razor-shark.description: Twenty paylines, mystery stacks and a separate golden shark reveal feature. The bonus centres on shifting stacks and a growing multiplier.
razor-shark.feature: Mystery stacks can reveal symbols and trigger Razor Reveal with instant multipliers and scatter symbols.
razor-shark.note: The base grid is conventional; the complexity comes from the features layered over it. Understand the mystery stacks before moving on to the bonus multipliers.
razor-shark.metricsNote: The original Razor Shark has no fixed maximum-win cap: Push Gaming confirms an actual win of 85 475.4x and explains that games without a cap show an observed reference figure, rather than an artificial ceiling.
additionalSourceLabels: Push Gaming Q&A about Razor Shark

wanted-dead-or-a-wild.description: Fifteen paylines and three markedly different bonus scenarios. VS symbols reveal entire Wild reels and add multipliers to paylines.
wanted-dead-or-a-wild.feature: DuelReels turn VS symbols into expanded Wild reels. Their multipliers are added together for a shared winning payline.
wanted-dead-or-a-wild.note: The game deliberately puts much of the attention on infrequent bonus situations. The number of effects on screen is not a useful measure of its pace.
wanted-dead-or-a-wild.metricsNote: The current detailed Hacksaw Gaming page lists Volatility: 4 / 5, so Slotfolio's public category remains High. At the same time, Hacksaw Gaming's general catalogue shows Wanted Dead Or a Wild with all five segments filled on its volatility meter, 5/5. The conflict between these two first-party pages is explicitly retained without raising the public category.
additionalSourceLabels: Current Hacksaw Gaming catalogue with the conflicting volatility meter 5/5

le-bandit.description: Cluster pays, super cascades and golden positions that retain a trace of winning locations. Coins, clovers and pots of gold add further layers.
le-bandit.feature: After a win, both the participating symbols and other matching symbols of the same type disappear from the grid, continuing the super cascade.
le-bandit.note: Le Bandit has several layers of rules, but the basic question is straightforward: where did the cluster form, and which positions turned golden afterwards?
le-bandit.passportSourceLabel: Official Hacksaw Gaming August release wrap dated 01.09.2023: Ronin Stackways on 10.08.2023, followed by Le Bandit two weeks later
